report.verdict: A quota-beating Account Executive whose resume doesn't yet show the customer success work this role requires.
write_up: Brightline's role is a different track from the one your resume shows. You moved from sales development to Account Executive at Vantage Fleet Software, with quota attainment and new business leading your story. A recruiter can see your sales results, but not whether you've owned renewals or managed customers after the sale.

The meetings line in your Sales Development Representative role is a good model: it names what you booked, for whom, and how often. Your Account Executive results are strong too, but the quota and closed-business figures need more context to compare them with other sales resumes.

Let's start with the FY2025 quota line, then add the period and deal context for the new business you closed. For Brightline, add any real post-sale account work you can speak to, without presenting sales work as customer success work.

cards.line: Vantage Fleet Software has no company description.
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter may not know what Vantage sells or who its customers are. One short description can give your sales results a setting.
cards.question: What does Vantage Fleet Software sell, and who are its customers?

cards.cannot_tell: 132% is a strong result, but a recruiter can't compare it without knowing the quota or territory behind it.
cards.example: Achieved 132% of quota in FY2025 against a [quota] quota for [territory]
cards.question: What was your FY2025 quota, and what territory did it cover?

cards.cannot_tell: The amount is clear, but the period and typical deal size aren't. Those details would help a sales recruiter understand the work behind it.
cards.example: Closed $1.4M in new business over [period], with a typical deal size of [deal size]
cards.question: What period does the $1.4M cover, and what was your typical deal size?

cards.line: Partnered with solutions engineers on demos and pilots
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter knows who you worked with, but not your part in the demos and pilots.
cards.example: Partnered with solutions engineers on demos and pilots, [your contribution]
cards.question: What was your part in the demos and pilots?

cards.line: Booked 25+ meetings per month for the account executive team
cards.cannot_tell: Keep this as a model. The action and monthly measure sit together, so a recruiter doesn't have to guess what the number counts.

fit.why: Your headline and current role both name Account Executive, and your recent work centers on quota and closing new business.
fit.level: mid-level, current Account Executive role and prior Sales Development Representative role
fit.note: Your full-cycle sales work and Salesforce experience are relevant to a move into customer-facing SaaS work. If you've done work with customers after closing, describe your part in it rather than leaving the recruiter to infer it.

posting.summary: Brightline seeks a mid-market Customer Success Manager to own accounts, drive retention and expansion, and work with customer usage data.
missing: 3+ years in customer success or account management at a SaaS company
A track record of hitting retention or expansion targets, with numbers you can talk about
a BI tool such as Looker
Experience running QBRs with VP-level sponsors
